verdict.rationale: Worldsmith builds simulated worlds from a natural-language description, and telemetry offers semantic search over event content. Natural language therefore drives some specific features, but general operation of the product is done through the browser UI and SDKs, not natural-language commands. Missing for 10: a general natural-language command interface or assistant for running evaluations, managing tasks and comparing agents; detailed docs on how Worldsmith interprets descriptions; independent or hands-on corroboration.
